name: ddlforge

scripts.test: npm run test:build && node --test dist/test/analyzer.test.js dist/test/runner.test.js dist/test/linter.test.js dist/test/reporter.test.js dist/test/wrapper.test.js dist/test/fuzz-parser.test.js dist/test/remediations.test.js dist/test/rules/concurrencyRules.test.js dist/test/rules/v070Rules.test.js
